scope: 15 periodic snapshots from one completed 8.6 repeat; observations are not independent. Only already-running decode requests change. Waiting/prefill requests retain their original targets. Oracle uses hindsight lengths and hypothetical probes; it is not measured latency or a deployable estimator. Half/double reserves are sensitivity controls, not fitted recommendations. Snapshots omit raw engine length predictions; original target is authoritative. max(original_target, generated+reserve) implements the rolling floor before caps.
